result:
No actions this turn. I've already read the booking app, and the open question below is your call, not something the code can answer.

Here's how I read it: members who book a lane get a text at 18:00 the evening before, so fewer lanes sit empty while people on the waiting list miss out. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" gets no texts from the club at all, reminders included.

What I found in the booking app:
- Nothing sends reminders today. The club already sends its newsletter by text through an SMS provider, so the reminders can go out the same way.
- 23% of members have ticked "no texts". Under rule 2, nearly a quarter of members would never get a reminder, which works against the goal of fewer no-shows.
- Email is blank for 61% of members. So email won't reach many of that 23% either.

Correct me if I've got any of that wrong.

The question that changes the build most is **what should a "no texts" member with a booking get?**

- **Nothing.** This is the simplest option and follows rule 2 to the letter. Their no-shows stay as they are today.
- **An email reminder, if they have an email address.** This reaches some of them and still respects their choice. It adds email sending, and members with neither texts nor email still get nothing.

I'd go with email where possible. Before we settle it, I can check how many "no texts" members actually have an email address, so we know whether it's worth adding.

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
